question: What roles as conqueror and supreme self are attributed to Viṣṇu?
premises: Viṣṇu is the conqueror of the enemies of the gods.
Salutation is directed to Viṣṇu in these roles.
inference: Viṣṇu is honored as both the victorious protector of the gods and the supreme self.
plain_english: Obeisance to Viṣṇu, conqueror of the enemies of the gods, the supreme self.
